selection: architecture: throughput pilot; alpha: disjoint development pilot; encoder and bridge: validation; recipient: full fixed budget
primary_budget: identical update count, fixed padded token count, 64 proof tokens and 3 QA tokens per problem exposure
scope: controlled constructive deduction; no claim of broad intelligence
boundary: final layer-normalized state before head; last UTF-8 byte of solution rendering for bridge y; last question byte for recipient h(q)
auxiliary_scaling: per-coordinate training language std from each frozen bridge; training only, detached targets

ordinary_corpus.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
ordinary_corpus.author: Lewis Carroll
ordinary_corpus.license: Public domain in the USA; Project Gutenberg license retained in the local source file
ordinary_corpus.partition: Strip Gutenberg START/END markers, encode UTF-8; first 90 percent of bytes train, remainder validation, before training
ordinary_corpus.tokenizer: Fixed local UTF-8 byte vocabulary: PAD=0, BOS=1, EOS=2, bytes=3..258. No external tokenizer or weights.
ordinary_corpus.download: curl --fail --location https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11.txt.utf-8 --output RUN/corpus/alice.txt; preflight checks exact SHA-256 and refuses changed content

development.selection_metric: development validation answer NLL after fixed 64 recipient updates

acceptance.pipeline: all admitted proofs have axiom-free real Lean receipts; train-only fitting; matched recipient budgets; independent reload verification
acceptance.research: report paired minus text-only held-out accuracy for every size and seed, including ties/declines; positive transfer not required

encoder.objective: independent proof-byte reconstruction through a 64D vector only

evaluation_boundary: question-only recipient reload, fixed A/B space prefix for likelihood, unconstrained greedy continuation; no bridge or proof at inference
